cards.scope: Fix the re-check's residual findings N1 to N4.
cards.evidenceText: Historical local evidence, superseded for readiness by the M14-F3-HOLD finding, which is now fixed and accepted locally by Gideon (Codex supervisor). N1 to N4 were fixed: reads at confirmed commitment with a fail-closed check, durable and fail-closed write-ahead and receipt files, and the packet pin recorded in write-ahead records. The once-only funding guard it added counts only confirmed records. Gideon (Codex supervisor) found that a missing or failed lookup after blockhash expiry could still bypass it. Tool tests 30/30 and runner tests 12/12 passed; the full plan passed; the real-node lifecycle ran in 24 s, down from 120 s. Coordinator-verified.

cards.owner: Sonnet worker; Silas (coordinator) runs the tests
cards.scope: Narrow fix: never treat a missing or failed signature lookup after blockhash expiry as proof that a transaction never landed.
cards.evidenceText: State detail: Done (Codex accepted locally). Gideon (Codex supervisor) source review found that, after a blockhash expired, a missing recent-cache status or a lookup error was recorded as never landed, so a landed funding transfer could have been sent twice. Fixed: lookups search transaction history, such records stay held as unknown and block execution, and only a later positive history result clears them, with a confirmed result restoring the once-only guard. The tool has no command to clear an unknown record. Gideon's (Codex supervisor) bounded independent closure review: PASS, local source and test boundary only. It found no blocking issue, read the zero-additional-send regressions and matched the test-summary hash. Gideon (Codex supervisor) did not re-run the tests; the coordinator's local runs are the test evidence. No approval implied.

Before anything was sent, a fresh check confirmed the network identity, the network clock, that no earlier send was uncertain, every pinned artifact, the stored proposal contents and approval times, and the payer balances. Both transactions reached the network's final confirmation level with no error, and both proposals read as executed.
